rows.jp: 「でも弁当だったら、机に置いておいてくれてもいいのに」
rows.en: “If it was just lunch, you could’ve left it on my desk.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But if it's just about the packed lunch, then you can leave it on the table."

rows.jp: 「発電所に……行けなかったから……」
rows.en: “Because... I couldn’t get to the power plant...”

ghs.en: Youko: "Because, power plant... I couldn't go..."

rows.jp: 「発電施設？　に行けなかった？」
rows.en: “The power facility? You couldn’t get there?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The power plant? You couldn't go there?"

rows.jp: 意味がわからない。
rows.en: I had no idea what she meant.

ghs.en: I don't understand what she means.

rows.jp: 黙った。
rows.en: She fell silent.

ghs.en: Fell silent.

rows.jp: くそう。
rows.en: Damn it.

ghs.en: Dammit.

rows.jp: いつものことながら、概要しか語らない。
rows.en: As usual, she’d given me nothing but the bare outline.

ghs.en: Always doing the same thing, never talking beyond the summary.

rows.jp: 自分が理解できる最低限の言葉で、語ってくるからだ。
rows.en: She only ever said enough for herself to understand what she meant.

ghs.en: She speaks only the absolute minimum words to let herself understand.

rows.jp: 問いつめることはできるが、こちらの質問や疑問を的確にしないと理解に辿り着くまで時間がかかって仕方ない。
rows.en: I could press her, but unless I framed every question exactly right, it took forever to piece together what she meant.

ghs.en: It's possible to press her on the issues, but if my questions and doubts are not formulated precisely it will still inevitably take a long time to reach understanding.

rows.jp: 「えー、つまり確認してきたんだ？　あんな遠くまで」
rows.en: “So, let me get this straight: you went all the way out there to check?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ehhh, in other words you went and checked it out? All the way out there?"

rows.jp: 「危険だったから」
rows.en: “Because it was dangerous.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Because it was dangerous."

rows.jp: 「ああ、そう……」
rows.en: “Right. Of course...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ah, I see..."

rows.jp: 確かに発電所がどうこうなったら危険である。
rows.en: A problem at the power plant certainly could have been dangerous.

ghs.en: Certainly with the way things are the power plant would be dangerous.

rows.jp: 「で、その報告に来たんだ」
rows.en: “So you came to report back.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "So, you came here to report that."

rows.jp: こく、と頷く。
rows.en: She nodded once.

ghs.en: Bob, she nods.

rows.jp: 「そうか……お疲れさま」
rows.en: “Got it... Good work.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well then... good job."

rows.jp: こく、と頷く。
rows.en: She nodded once.

ghs.en: Bob, she nods.

rows.jp: ちょっと嬉しそうだ。
rows.en: She looked a little pleased.

ghs.en: Seems sort of happy.

rows.jp: 手を離す。
rows.en: I let go of her.

ghs.en: I release her from my hand.

rows.jp: 彼女の白磁の頬が、すこし赤く腫れていた。
rows.en: Her porcelain-white cheek was slightly red and swollen.

ghs.en: Her porcelain white cheeks swelled somewhat red.

rows.jp: にしても。
rows.en: Still.

ghs.en: Regardless,

rows.jp: 行けなかった、とはどういうことだろう。
rows.en: What did she mean, she couldn’t get there?

ghs.en: she could not go, but what does that even mean?

rows.jp: 崖崩れがあって物理的にたどり着けなかったとか。
rows.en: Had a landslide made the place physically inaccessible?

ghs.en: The path was broken down by a landslide, maybe, that she couldn't physically make her way there at all.

rows.jp: 施設の運用には必要を満たしているが、その周囲はきっちり難儀な土地だからなぁ。
rows.en: The facility had everything it needed to operate, but the surrounding terrain was a nightmare.

ghs.en: The terrain surrounding it can certainly satisfy the requirements for the purpose of the facility, but it's still veeery challenging land indeed.

rows.jp: でも安全と言い切るってことは……確認が取れたってことで。
rows.en: But if she was certain it was safe... then she must have confirmed that much somehow.

ghs.en: But to definitely assert that it is safe... confirmation must be acquired.

rows.jp: んー。
rows.en: Hmm.

ghs.en: Hmmm.

rows.jp: 「その行けなかったってのは？」
rows.en: “What do you mean, you couldn’t get there?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Why could you not go?"

rows.jp: いなくなっていた。
rows.en: She was gone.

ghs.en: She was nowhere to be seen.

rows.jp: ちょっと目を離した隙に。
rows.en: The moment I took my eyes off her.

ghs.en: Gone, in the tiny gap I took my eyes off her.

rows.en: “Haaah...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Sigh..."
